blurb: Our dad became a certified Infant Swimming Resource (ISR) instructor after Adam drowned. ISR teaches babies and toddlers to roll onto their backs, float and breathe if they ever end up in the water alone, the lessons Adam never got the chance to take.
stance: Our family recommends ISR specifically: not just any swim lessons, and not “mommy and me” water play. The day it counts, there’s no parent in the water.
disclosure: Our dad is a certified ISR instructor. His lessons are his own business, separate from Because of ADAM, and Because of ADAM doesn’t receive income from swim lessons. Use ISR’s official map to find any certified instructor near you.
